translation.name: Sleeping bag / blanket
profile: A sleeping bag or blanket helps provide ordinary comfort for resting away from inhabited places. In Elaria, it may be a family gift, part of a caravan's equipment, or a reminder of past journeys. A pattern, patch, or small personal possession tucked inside can say something about the hero without changing game values.

It is useful when camping and preparing a place where the party wants to spend the night safely. Comfortable rest still requires suitable conditions; a blanket alone does not remove the need for a watch, dangerous weather, or a curse. The catalog grants no automatic recovery of a specific number of hit points. Caring for a shared camp can provide opportunities for conversation, helping one another, and building relationships.

Rules effect: Comfortable rest outdoors. The price is 3 sp. The item is reusable rather than a single-use supply. Its listed effect applies to the situation it is intended for. Additional bonuses, other forms of protection, and new magical abilities are not part of this entry.

strings.Přesný řádek této položky má přednost př: This item's exact entry overrides the general formula only where explicitly stated. Vaelor does not add any further hidden bonuses.
This item's effects, requirements, and price.
strings.Lze použít i jako vrhací zbraň: Can also be used as a thrown weapon
